name: recovery/replay-slow-steady-server
description: A replay whose frames arrive steadily but whose total duration exceeds the recovery deadline (10s) must NOT interrupt: each frame is recovery progress that re-arms the deadline, so it fires only on true server silence. The gap arms the deadline at t=0; a replay_message at t=6s (6s < 10s silence) keeps it alive; replay_complete at t=12s (>10s total) ends the cycle cleanly. Expected: exactly the one replay, no raise_recovery_interrupted.
